title: Uncovering Bias in Large Vision-Language Models with Counterfactuals

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text generated by Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) in response to open-ended prompts and counterfactual images varying the subject's gender. The outputs are assessed using the Perspective API (toxicity, insult, identity attack, flirtation scores) and lexical analysis based on the Stereotype Content Model (warmth and competence words).

Evaluating LVLM text generations using counterfactual images that vary the subject's race across different occupational contexts. The generated text is analyzed for toxic content using the Perspective API and for stereotypical descriptions using word counts associated with competence and warmth.

Analyzing LVLM responses to counterfactual images varying physical characteristics such as body weight (obese, skinny) and body modifications (tattooed). The text is evaluated using Perspective API toxicity classifiers to identify insults and offensive stereotypes.

Testing LVLM generations on counterfactual images depicting variations in the subject's age (old vs. young) while holding other visual elements constant, then measuring the toxicity and identity attack scores of the generated text via the Perspective API.
